T300 was rejected by agent-082c and is available again: See docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-home-stretch/REVIEW-2.md. 1) should-fix, reproduced: src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx:248/264 falls back to the session-local localOrder (reset only on project.id change) when props.groupOrder is undefined. After restoring a version with no sidebarOrder, the sidebar still shows the old heading order while Read/export (project.order) put Manuscript first. Repro: add Part two+Alpha, snapshot, move Part two up, restore: sidebar Part two first, export Opening first. It persists after an edit until reload. Fix: when props.onGroupOrder is given, use only props.groupOrder (sidebarOrder: props.onGroupOrder ? props.groupOrder : localOrder), or reset localOrder when groupOrder changes; add a Playwright case (snapshot, move heading, restore, then assert sidebar order == export order). 2) low: ProjectSidebar.tsx:781-783 More is drawn left of split (order:-1) but tabbed after it; optional DOM reorder. 3) low: built-in restore-default only by typing the default name (dialog refuses empty); optional 'Restore default name' item. 4) low, mostly pre-existing: styles.css:2112 (and :714) pad the whole .entry-main incl. .entry-preview, so hovering a card with body text re-wraps it and moves the cards below by 18px; pad the title span instead (probed: zero shifts). The hs9 spec's no-shift case uses empty cards. Everything else checked fine: normalisation, orphans, delete, drag, search, spy, tints, tests.

T301 was rejected by agent-fd1b and is available again: REVIEW-4.md. 1) should-fix: src/App.tsx:100-108 unsavedDocumentSettings restates Writer's fallbacks (src/Writer.tsx:339-346 size 14/line 1.5/margin, :1131 indent) as separate literals; values match today but can drift. Fix: export one constant (e.g. editorFallbackSettings in src/research/types.ts) and have Writer read documentSettings ?? it and App merge onto it. 2) medium, coordinator/owner decision, not a worker defect: on a no-settings project the Page setup toggle now flips the EXPORT (Times New Roman 12 double+indent -> Sans 14 1.5 no indent; probed), since export merges onto defaultDocumentSettings (src/export/document.ts:91); the Export panel checkbox (App.tsx:2635) and Bibliography (App.tsx:2667) still flip the editor. Rest fine: splittableMarks filter, label, System font box, Writer HS2/5/7/8 edits all present, with-settings toggle changes only pageNumbers, writes via mutate.
